description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions (k) and the majority voting accuracy. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and is a linear scale ranging from 2^0 to 2^8. The y-axis is labeled "Majority voting accuracy" and is a linear scale ranging from 0.3 to 0.6. There are three lines in the plot, each with a different color, marker shape, and line style. The blue line with square markers and a solid line style represents one dataset, the green line with triangle markers and a dashed line style represents another dataset, and the light blue line with circle markers and a dash-dot line style represents a third dataset. The blue line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.4 and ends at an accuracy of approximately 0.6, showing a steady increase. The green line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.3 and ends at an accuracy of approximately 0.4, also showing a steady increase. The light blue line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.3 and ends at an accuracy of approximately 0.35, showing a slight increase.
